rules.title: Char Dham: register yourself and your vehicle
rules.detail: Registration is compulsory and free on the state tourism board's portal, for every traveller and vehicle, before setting out. The portal does not single out two-wheelers.

rules.title: Char Dham: green card, trip card and vehicle registration
rules.detail: Commercial vehicles need a green card and a trip card. Private vehicles are registered on the same portal, user charge Rs 50. Trip validity is ten days for four shrines.

rules.title: Shrine opening and closing dates are set each year
rules.detail: Dates follow the Hindu calendar. Closing dates are declared on Vijayadashami, Badrinath's opening on Basant Panchami and Kedarnath's opening on Mahashivratri.

gaps: Highway numbers NH 107, NH 34 and NH 134 come from their own encyclopedia pages, which were opened; no official source was used.
2026 closing dates had not been declared by 28 September 2026; only tentative dates on operator sites were found.
No source says whether motorcycles must register on the green card portal or only on the tourism portal; the official pages do not mention two-wheelers.
The night travel ban is known from news reports, which disagree on the hours; the government order was not found.
Who announces the Gangotri and Yamunotri dates was not sourced.
Uttarakhand green cess: the exemption for two-wheelers is reported by two news outlets; no Transport Department order or official page was found.

Shrine dates not sourced on an opened page: 2022 October closings of Kedarnath, Yamunotri and Gangotri; 2023 openings and closings of Kedarnath, Gangotri and Yamunotri; 2024 Badrinath opening. The 2022 openings come from an operator page only.
Only one rider video found. Its title and channel were read from the video page; filming date and motorcycle are not confirmed.
Some stretch distances are doubtful. The open map may not know the road riders use, so the routing service went the long way round.
